name: t13-read-v6
idea_origin: DeepSeek line, 27 Oct night; ideas from Matteo's observed-growth-v10 (branch matteo/main): best value at the level, two-month review window, repair at once
hypothesis: An official t13-read-v2 game stayed 27 months at L2 because Network or Output dropped one or two points with the last story choices before four reviews in a row; another ended by the runner's continuation limit after late calls (context near 200k tokens) came back as a canned provider reply. Naming the everyday ways of losing Network in the review month, a cooperative fallback, and short English notes should keep more promotions and finish more runs.
predicted_behaviour: More reviews passed at L2 and L3 than t13-read-v2; shorter assistant text; no max_continuations endings.
refutation: Promotions missed at the same rate as t13-read-v2, or runs still ending at the continuation limit.
